branch: #modelFooter renders three .tgl switches; the 1M switch transforms the selection value and the gauge denominator both ways; fast gating follows the roster's supportsFastMode; __fastMode/__thinking frames drive the switches
provenance: The five roster items in step 1 are copied VERBATIM from the CLI's initialize/list_models response, probed live over stdio 2026-08-24 against CLI 2.1.241 (value/resolvedModel/supportsFastMode are the CLI's own) — they prove what the panel does WITH the real shape, not what the CLI sends. The __fastMode and __thinking frames are OUR OWN Kotlin->webview frames (self-consistency only, by design — they never claim CLI provenance). The 1M switch deliberately carries NO validity logic (user decision 2026-08-24): any model can be flipped and an unsupported combination fails on the NEXT TURN with the API's own error (measured: set_model haiku[1m] -> success, then one real turn -> 'API Error: 400 The long context beta is not yet available for this subscription'). Menus are opened by CLICKING THE CHIP, never by adding .show (tg() positioning gotcha). The 1M switch IS clicked for real — it must drive setModel — so the final step restores the pre-fixture selection through the same setModel path (persistence included) and re-injects the saved roster; fast/thinking are exercised through injected frames only, because their clicks would persist preferences and send apply_flag_settings to the live CLI. result-frame reconciliation IS asserted (the mm4b step) by calling reconcileFromResult() directly — the exact function onResult runs — because injecting a whole raw result would draw summary chrome into the log; the step saves and restores ctxWindowFromCli so the live gauge is untouched. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-08-24 against the pre-change webview (whole webview/ dir restored to HEAD via git stash, sandbox restarted, control verified BY CONTENT: #modelFooter absent): step 1's display GUARD passed and all three DISCRIMINATING asserts failed with None (rows None != 3, rail delta None != 0, svgSlot None != 20 — no #modelFooter in the DOM; the rail assert was textDelta in that run and became iconDelta after the first fixed-build run measured the real contract — model rows have no .pi-ic slot, so the footer's ICON sits on the title rail and the label text is 30px right of it, exactly as the approved mockup renders; both variants read None in the control for the same reason); step 2's setup then threw 'Cannot read properties of null (reading classList)' on the missing #tgl1m and the harness aborted the run there, so steps 3-5 never executed in the control — the discrimination is the step-1 failures plus that abort. SECOND CONTROL 2026-08-24 for the mm4b step (added with the oneMFromCli reconciliation; its increment shares files with the feature, so a stash control was not separable): wrong-value variant — snappedOn and clearedOnNewModel expectations flipped to false against the patched build FAILED exactly those two asserts (26 passed, 2 failed), then reverted to 28/0 — proving both are live and discriminating, not vacuous.
